metadata.purpose: Organize 908 semantic records into execution families for minimum-deep-experiment qualification strategy

execution_families.description: Numeric scalar parameters mappable to VST3 host parameters or Serum body fields

representation.serialization: VST3 parameter value or Serum state field

execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: For each family member: (1) resolve target, (2) attempt mutation, (3) readback, (4) type check, (5) range validation
known_exceptions: FILTER type-specific parameters (BODY_STATE_FIELD, not plain scalar)
execution_families.qualification_status: PARTIAL (Release proven, others awaiting representative verification)

execution_families.description: Parameters whose existence/meaning depends on a parent state (filter type, LFO mode, etc.)

representation.serialization: Serum state body field; requires parent state to be meaningful

execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: For each condition (filter type, LFO mode): verify readback with parent state set correctly. Omit readback validation if parent state differs.
Row similarity: all 16 matrix rows use same routing logic. Verify one row (source, destination, amount), apply to remaining 15 rows.
execution_families.qualification_status: PARTIAL_ESTABLISHED (status: ESTABLISHED in control path matrix)

execution_families.description: UI-only actions: toggles, buttons, mode selections without direct readback

representation.serialization: Live UI state, no direct Serum readback
representation.readback_strategy: Implicit (assumes UI action succeeds unless exception noted)

representative_deep_experiments: MACRO.01.NAME (TODO — toggle name editor, verify UI state changes)
ARP.PATTERN.SYNCED (TODO — toggle ARP sync, verify pattern state)
execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Per section: (1) attempt UI action in Live, (2) observe UI state change, (3) record success/exception. No deep measurement required.
known_exceptions: Some FX UI actions may trigger preset loading (RESOURCE_OPERATION)
Some CLIP actions may fail if clip not selected

execution_families.description: Browser operations: preset loading, sample loading, resource navigation, metadata

representation.serialization: Serum preset/sample state, not a scalar parameter

execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Browser operations are user-facing UI actions. Verify: (1) preset loads via Live browser, (2) state persists in Serum, (3) no crashes. No measurement required.
execution_families.qualification_status: ESTABLISHED (pure UI navigation, no deep control needed)

execution_families.description: One VST3 parameter or state field represents multiple semantic controls

representation.pattern: One physical parameter maps to multiple user-facing semantic controls
representation.example: SUB.Enable controls both MIXER.SUB.ENABLE and MIXER.SUB.PAN (Enable state affects Pan meaning)

execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Same physical parameter: verify representative, apply to all other semantics sharing it.
execution_families.qualification_status: PARTIAL_ESTABLISHED (status: ESTABLISHED in control path matrix)

execution_families.description: Structural operations: add/remove modules, reorder, bypass, context menus

representation.serialization: Serum topology state, not a scalar

execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Per operation type: (1) attempt operation in Live, (2) observe topology change, (3) verify Serum state reflects change.

execution_families.description: One semantic control operates multiple targets simultaneously (e.g., graphic EQ filter cutoff affects both Filter 1 and 2)

representation.pattern: One semantic_id maps to multiple target_ids

representative_deep_experiments: MIXER.FILTER1.GRAPHIC_CUTOFF_RESONANCE (TODO — mutate both targets, verify both readback)
execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Same logic applies to other mixer multi-target: verify one, apply pattern.
execution_families.qualification_status: PARTIAL_ESTABLISHED (status: ESTABLISHED in control path matrix)

execution_families.description: Semantics with unresolved execution paths; requires investigation

representation.pattern: No clear target, operation, or execution mechanism identified yet

representative_deep_experiments: Sample FX semantic (e.g., FX.DISTORTION.ENABLED) — determine if scalar param or UI action
Sample GLOBAL semantic (e.g., GLOBAL.MASTER_TUNING) — determine execution mechanism
execution_families.lightweight_member_verification: Categorize each UNKNOWN by inspection + light UI check. Escalate to deep experiment only if ambiguous.

summary.estimated_lightweight_verifications: 600+ member verifications (most by category, not individual)
